description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended fruquintinib, within its marketing authorisation, as an option at third line or later to treat metastatic colorectal cancer in adults when previous treatment has included fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, and irinotecan-based chemotherapy (with or without anti-VEGF treatment), and anti-EGFR treatment if the cancer is RAS wild-type (unless not suitable). Fruquintinib is recommended only when trifluridine-tipiracil with bevacizumab is not suitable, within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
